get.x-public: starts the sign-in: the caller has no session yet
completes the sign-in: the caller has no session yet
answers 401 itself when the cookie holds no live session

post.x-public: ends the session in the cookie, or answers 401 itself and clears it
a CI job proves itself with its GitLab id_token; there is no session or token yet

get.x-signed-in: lists only the organizations the caller holds a role in

post.x-public: GitLab calls it with the connection's webhook secret, which the handler checks
post.x-no-audit: the delivery row and the job it creates are the record; nothing here is a change by a user
read-only: renders and lints, writes nothing to GitLab or the database (it does use the connection to read the repository)

post.x-signed-in: creates a token for the caller; the handler refuses callers that are not users

delete.x-signed-in: revokes one of the caller's own tokens; anyone else's is not found

post.x-no-audit: read-only: a search changes nothing, and what it looks for stays out of the log
